title: Automation acts only on reviewed semantic capabilities (known)
rationale: R1-D reconstructed the current primary Cockpit and compatibility GameStore automation surfaces and closed the confirmed execution fractures in canonical command execution, mixed guided resolution, and stored-target success reporting. The registered paths are bounded and fail closed or fall back to manual handling for unsupported semantics, but there is still no exhaustive machine-enforced capability manifest proving that every production automation recognizer is mapped to reviewed semantic evidence; a global MATCH/GAP/CONFLICT verdict therefore remains unjustified.
nextAction: Keep UNKNOWN until a later M6-bounded control-plane step establishes an exhaustive automation capability manifest with freshness enforcement. Treat the registered primary Cockpit and compatibility GameStore paths as the current audited surface; any new automation ingress must invalidate and re-audit CR-15.
